verdict.rationale: Secureframe ships a first-party MCP server so that assistants such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Cursor can look up data and take actions on your behalf. That lets users query and update controls, tests, vendors, risks and more in natural language, but only through an external MCP client. The in-product Comply AI features (policy drafting, risk scoring, questionnaire extraction) are generative helpers, not a natural-language command interface. missing for 10: native in-app natural-language command/chat interface, documentation of which write actions are supported via natural language, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Any MCP-capable client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and others) can connect, letting you ask an assistant to look things up and take actions on your behalf.
Connect an AI assistant to your Secureframe workspace and query or update your compliance data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
The Secureframe MCP server allows you to access and manage your Secureframe data — controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, risks, and more — as Model Context Protocol tools.
